annotations.summary: API has no observed available replica
annotations.description: Check Deployment, probes, Service and an actual HTTP request. Missing Kubernetes telemetry is unknown availability; recovery requires fresh replicas and HTTP success.

rules.expr: (max((lab_outbox_pending_events{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} and on(instance) (lab_outbox_stats_up{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - lab_outbox_stats_last_success_timestamp_seconds{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"}) < 30) and on(instance) (up{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} == 1))) > 10) or ((max((lab_outbox_pending_events{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} and on(instance) (lab_outbox_stats_up{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - lab_outbox_stats_last_success_timestamp_seconds{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"}) < 30) and on(instance) (up{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} == 1))) > 0) and (max((lab_outbox_oldest_pending_age_seconds{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} and on(instance) (lab_outbox_stats_up{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - lab_outbox_stats_last_success_timestamp_seconds{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"}) < 30) and on(instance) (up{namespace="kubernetes-application-lab",job="lab-publisher"} == 1))) > 60))

annotations.summary: Fresh outbox backlog exceeds the laboratory threshold
annotations.description: Inspect publisher SQL sampler, Kafka bootstrap, TLS and delivery errors. Restore publisher; confirm fresh pending=0 and job completion. Missing/stale SQL samples are not an empty queue.
Check all three partition offsets, exporter health and group members. Restore consumer progress and confirm committed offsets equal log end; missing or negative lag is unknown.

annotations.summary: Known queued work has no observed worker progress
annotations.description: Inspect worker availability, SQL, retries, DLQ and offset commits. Processed is a sampled process counter, not proof of SQL effects. Recovery requires job/SQL and lag checks.
Inspect retry reason, durable SQL receipt and bounded DLQ reader. Do not replay automatically. Resolved means the counter window aged out, not that the failed job was repaired.
Distinguish exporter target failure/missing series from pg_up=0. Check exporter credentials and PostgreSQL independently; recover fresh pg_up=1 and exporter UP.
